title: Start here — Foreign Runtime v0.22.6
summary: Foreign Runtime v0.22.6 is the current continuation candidate. It provides native library/schema invocation, managed memory/structs, callbacks, optional Python provider/proxies, bidirectional buffers, ForeignTensor/DLPack and ABI-qualified metadata. v0.17.2 remains accepted concurrency-repair ancestry.
invariants: Fixed-width metadata remains fixed-width; host C aliases resolve from compiled ABI.
ABI-specific layouts/constants fail closed unless independently qualified.
Optional providers do not redefine the base runtime authority.
